entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Hi Morgan, thanks for joining. This call is transcribed for my notes; is that all right?

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Walk me through a system you owned.

entries.speaker: Morgan Ellery
entries.text: I owned the motor controller firmware on our last vehicle. I built the fault logger and debugged a brownout reset that only showed up below freezing.

entries.speaker: Morgan Ellery
entries.text: We traced it to a capacitor that lost capacity in the cold, so the supply sagged during startup. A firmware delay covered it until the board was respun.

entries.speaker: Morgan Ellery
entries.text: I want to keep working close to hardware, and I like being in the room when it gets tested.

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Great. You'll hear from me by Wednesday about the hiring manager screen, and it's already on the calendar for Friday.
